layers.atom: member raw score s_j on each signal day's legal pool
layers.layer2_expert: q_g = mean over seeds of r_t(s_j) (no re-rank inside the expert)
layers.layer3_fusion: u = sum_g w_g * q_g, w_g>=0, sum w_g = 1

candidates.TREEFUSION_v1: trunk=MAIN_SEED_ENSEMBLE_v1 (L3 x3 seeds), expert=L5 seed-mean, alpha=0.5
candidates.CATFUSION_v1: trunk=MAIN_SEED_ENSEMBLE_v1, expert=CatBoost C1 (IC-selected trees) x3 seeds, alpha=0.5

note: IR must be reported from the final actual output graph; earlier rank-preserving graphs are separate identities
